name: code-awareness
description: Local context and reliability infrastructure for AI-assisted software engineering
author: Eric Rocha

scripts.postinstall: npm run native:prepare && npm run native:doctor
scripts.build: electron-vite build && node scripts/local-mcp/build.cjs && npm run native:bundle-guard
scripts.test:run: npm run test:node && npm run test:git && npm run test:native
scripts.test:node: npm run test:lanes:guard && node scripts/test-output.cjs run -- node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run
scripts.test:native: npm run native:doctor && npm run test:lanes:guard && node scripts/run-vitest-electron.cjs run --config vitest.native.config.ts
scripts.test:db: npm run native:doctor && npm run test:db:adapter && npm run test:db:codemap
scripts.test:codemap:native: npm run native:doctor && npm run test:lanes:guard && node scripts/run-vitest-electron.cjs run --config vitest.native.config.ts src/main/core/codemap-addressability.test.ts src/main/core/codemap-extraction-contract.test.ts src/main/core/codemap-startup.e2e.test.ts src/main/core/codemap-system-acceptance.e2e.test.ts src/main/core/context-reference.e2e.test.ts src/main/core/symbol-reference-persistence.e2e.test.ts
scripts.test:git: npm run test:lanes:guard && node scripts/test-output.cjs run -- node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --config vitest.git.config.ts
scripts.test:git:heavy: npm run test:lanes:guard && node scripts/test-output.cjs run -- node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --config vitest.git-heavy.config.ts
scripts.test:git:rest: npm run test:lanes:guard && node scripts/test-output.cjs run -- node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --config vitest.git-rest.config.ts
scripts.test:compression: npm run test:lanes:guard && node scripts/test-output.cjs run -- node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run src/main/core/compression-service.test.ts
scripts.benchmark:repo-map-real: npm run native:doctor && node scripts/run-vitest-electron.cjs run --config vitest.benchmark.config.ts
scripts.test:context:node: npm run test:lanes:guard && node scripts/test-output.cjs run -- node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run src/main/core/tokenizer.test.ts src/main/core/dash src/renderer/src/components/CodeDashView src/main/ipc/dash-handler-v2.test.ts
scripts.test:ui: npm run test:lanes:guard && node scripts/test-output.cjs run -- node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run src/renderer/src/components/CodeJourneyView/restore-modal.test.tsx
scripts.native:validate: npm run native:doctor && npm run build
scripts.validate:codemap: npm run test:codemap:native && npm run test:db:codemap && npm run native:doctor && echo CODEMAP VALID
scripts.validate:context: npm run benchmark:tokenizer && npm run test:context:node && npm run test:context:native && npm run benchmark:repo-map-real && echo CONTEXT VALID
scripts.validate: npm run native:policy:test && npm run native:preflight:test && npm run test:lanes:guard:test && npm run test:git:guard:test && npm run native:doctor && npm run typecheck:test && npm run typecheck && npm run test:node && npm run harness:desktop:test && npm run validate:codemap && npm run validate:context && npm run test:db:adapter && npm run build && npm run native:doctor
scripts.harness:ui:preflight: node scripts/test-output.cjs run -- node scripts/ui-visual-validation/harness.cjs preflight
